d: Calo is an app providing personalized meal plans for busy people through nutritional algorithms, built with love by chefs, nutritionists, and software engineers.

Launched in Bahrain in 2019, we have since expanded to 6 countries, delivered millions of meals to our customers, and are now expanding our mission of making healthy easy to retail and other verticals.
We're on a noble mission to make healthy easy. We think this is one of the most important problems to tackle in our world today. We have global ambitions - no small thinking here.

The successful candidate will oversee brand plans, manage marketing campaigns and work with internal teams and external partners to deliver effective execution.
The Client’s Definition of the Ideal Fit
5+ years of experience in brand management or a similar marketing role.
Experience developing and executing brand strategies and marketing plans.
Strong understanding of brand positioning, consumer behaviour and market trends.
Experience managing marketing campaigns, product launches and brand activations.
Ability to monitor brand performance and use market insights to guide marketing decisions.
Experience managing marketing budgets and working with external agencies.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Based in Kuwait or willing to relocate to Kuwait City.
This is an opportunity to take on a senior brand role within a large conglomerate and contribute to the growth of its brand portfolio.
